title: Capital Punishment in the United States, 1973-1989
description:
This data collection provides annual data on prisoners under
a sentence of death and on those whose offense sentences were commuted
or vacated during the period 1973-1989. Information is supplied on
basic sociodemographic characteristics such as age, sex, race and
ethnicity, marital status at time of imprisonment, level of education,
and state of incarceration. Criminal history data include prior felony
convictions for criminal homicide and legal status at the time of the
capital offense. Additional information is available for those inmates
removed from death row by yearend 1989 and for those inmates who were
executed.
